mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO agency in a competitive market like New York City?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an AEO agency in a competitive market such as New York City, look for agencies with a proven track record of securing featured snippets and knowledge panel placements for clients in diverse industries. Evaluate their expertise in natural language processing, schema markup, and data analysis. Request case studies or client references to assess their results. Consider their communication style and reporting transparency to ensure a collaborative partnership. A local agency with understanding of regional search trends can be beneficial, but prioritize specialized experience and a clear strategy over proximity alone. Ensure they offer a tailored approach, not a one-size-fits-all solution.
